plan.summary:
The PR keys snapshots by project instead of a bare UUID. It also changes snapshot expiry and flush behavior.

- `stale` returns `SnapshotKey` values instead of `Uuid`.
- `stale` now treats entries with `expires <= now` as stale. Before, only `expires < now` counted.
- `shouldFlush` now returns true when `force` is set, even with nothing pending.
plan.riskRationale: The expiry boundary change can remove snapshots that were kept before. The return type change affects callers. The flush change is small. No tests appear in the diff.
plan.storyArc: The main change gives snapshots a project-scoped key and fixes how expiry is judged. A separate small fix makes `shouldFlush` honor its `force` argument.

topics.title: Project-scoped snapshot keys and expiry boundary
topics.narrativeBrief: What does `stale` return now, and which entries count as stale? Verify the `SnapshotKey` type and the `<` to `<=` change. Check that callers still work with the new return type.

topics.title: Honor force in shouldFlush
topics.narrativeBrief: When does `shouldFlush` return true now? It now returns true if `force` is set, even with no pending items. Verify that callers expect this.
